[New]

📦 **DHL without an account**: Track DHL Parcel numbers (JJD…, 3S…) with just the tracking number — in the device settings, while pairing or from a Flow. A My DHL account is optional now.

🚚 **DHL Express with parcels**: Track DHL Express shipments with their **10-digit air waybill**, no account needed. Your MyDHL+ login keeps working and can be combined.

🧾 **More DHL parcel data**: New capabilities and Flow tokens for **next delivery, out for delivery, ServicePoint / Packstation, ready for pickup, recently delivered, sent parcels, last event, status history** and a direct tracking link. DHL Express adds **pieces, origin** and the **proof-of-delivery** link.

⚡ **New DHL Flow cards** on all three DHL devices: triggers for **new parcel, tracking event, out for delivery, ready for pickup, problem or returning** and **sent parcels**, conditions for **out for delivery, ready for pickup, a parcel has status…, parcel … is delivered** and **parcel … is being tracked**, and actions to **track a parcel, stop tracking** and **remove delivered parcels**.

🇩🇪 **Post & DHL Germany like Home Assistant**: Packstation pickups with the Packstation address, returns and sent parcels, plus an optional **DHL.de login** (from a German internet connection) for extra tracking numbers.

🧩 **DHL Pakete widget** for Post & DHL Germany, and all DHL devices now show up in **MyParcel Pakketten** and **MyParcel Bezorging** with the right status and timeline.

🎨 **DHL Express** now uses the same device images as DHL.

[Fix]

🔁 **No more repeated DHL triggers**: “Shipment delivered” fired for every old parcel right after pairing and again when DHL briefly dropped and re-listed a parcel. Every DHL trigger now fires **once per change**, also after an app restart.

📬 **DHL statuses recognised**: Out for delivery, ready at a ServicePoint, delivered at the neighbours or in the mailbox and returns were not recognised by DHL — DHL's own status codes are now used.

🔌 **DHL Express “Not connected”**: The connection status of DHL Express switched to “Not connected” every 30 seconds and the delivery-window trigger fired twice.

🔐 **DHL Express session**: An expired MyDHL+ session now signs in again instead of failing on every refresh.

💥 **Post & DHL Germany crash**: The device could crash on start and stop polling; login tokens are now saved immediately after a refresh.

[Improvement]

⏱️ **Smart polling for DHL**: Every **15 minutes** when a delivery is near, every **30–45 minutes** otherwise, and quiet at night.

🧠 **Status history only when needed**: DHL history is only fetched when a parcel's status changes.

🐢 **Friendly to DHL Express**: Air waybills are looked up within DHL Express' own budget (one lookup per 40 minutes), shipments with the courier first, and MyParcel backs off when DHL asks to slow down.

🌐 **No more “unavailable” on a hiccup**: A network hiccup shows a warning with the last known data instead of making the DHL device unavailable.

🗑️ **Delivered parcels tidy up**: Delivered DHL parcels are hidden after a configurable number of days.

🌟 Enjoy the improved MyParcel v0.3.4 App with all three DHL services rebuilt, parcels without an account and DHL in every MyParcel widget.
